mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT P.PORTFOLIO_ID id, P.PORTFOLIO_NAME text FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO P
AND (P.PORTFOLIO_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR P.PORTFOLIO_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))

select FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, NVL(FINPROD_ABBR, FINPROD_NAME) text from FIN_PRODUCT fp
fp.TRADE_MARKET = '01'
AND (fp.FINPROD_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR fp.FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))

SELECT COUNTER_ID id, COUNTER_NAME "text", CASE WHEN COUNTER_TYPE=#{COUNTER_TYPE} THEN #{YES_NO_N} ELSE #{YES_NO_Y} END "object" FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY
AND ( COUNTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )

select T1.BUSI_PS busiPs, T.COUNTER_ID counterId, T.COUNTER_TRADER counterTrader, T1.TERM_TYPE termType,
T1.SETTLE_SPREED settleSpreed, T.CCY ccy, T.entrust_id entrustId, T.FINPROD_ID finprodId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName from ETR_ENTRUST T left join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T1 on T.entrust_id = T1.entrust_id left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on T.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID where T.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
